name: sentry
description: Developer-first error tracking and performance monitoring
one_liner: A tool that watches a live app and instantly tells developers when something breaks or slows down, pointing to the exact line of code responsible.
buyer: Any software company's engineering lead who needs to know about bugs in production before customers complain.
business_use_cases: A SaaS startup gets alerted the moment a new feature breaks for real users in production, instead of waiting for support tickets.
An e-commerce company catches checkout-flow errors, like payment failures, within seconds instead of losing sales silently.
A dev agency offers 'production monitoring setup' as a standard add-on when it ships client projects.

money_ideas.idea: Resell and manage a hosted instance with white-glove setup and alerting rules for small businesses that don't have in-house DevOps.

steal_this: Offer a one-day 'get your production app properly monitored' service this weekend to a local startup, using it as the backbone.
